plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ericsson IPOS routers (Router 6000 / SSR 8000, enterprise PEN 193.218). It reports uptime, CPU utilization, per-module memory, entity temperature, fan and power supply state, and interface traffic. MINI-LINK microwave devices (PEN 193.223) are covered by the transmission Ericsson template instead.
name: Router

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Ericsson IPOS router as a five-minute cumulative average (ERICSSON-ROUTER-CPU-METER-MIB eriRouterCpuMeterFiveMinuteAvg, whole percent 0-100). Sustained high CPU usage may indicate control-plane overload or routing churn.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the memory in use for each memory module of the Ericsson IPOS router (eriRouterMemoryKBytesInUse, KiB converted to bytes at collection).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports the free memory for each memory module of the Ericsson IPOS router (eriRouterMemoryFreeKBytes, KiB converted to bytes at collection).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total memory of each memory module of the Ericsson IPOS router, computed as used + free.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the memory utilization of each memory module of the Ericsson IPOS router, computed as used / (used + free) * 100. Sustained high usage may indicate memory leaks or oversized tables.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature of each entity sensor of the Ericsson IPOS router in degrees Celsius (ERICSSON-ROUTER-ENVMON-MIB eriRouterEntityTempCurrent; the device clamps readings to 0-100). High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or airflow obstruction.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the state of each fan tray of the Ericsson IPOS router (eriRouterFanStatus, raw normal(1) / failed(2) / absent(3) / unknown(4)), normalized so that normal/absent = 1 (healthy), failed = 2 (fault), unknown = 3 (grey, does not alert). Empty slots keep a row. Only value 2 alerts.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: This metric reports the speed of each fan unit of the Ericsson IPOS router in RPM (eriRouterFanSpeedCurrent).

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the state of each power module of the Ericsson IPOS router (eriRouterPowerStatus, raw normal(1) / failed(2) / absent(3) / unknown(4)), normalized so that normal/absent = 1 (healthy), failed = 2 (fault), unknown = 3 (grey, does not alert). Empty slots keep a row. Only value 2 alerts.
